This 900hp restomod is a rally legend reborn for the road

Don't fancy getting your supercar muddy? There's now a tarmac-only version — for a seven-figure sum

SK
Sam Keller
Published: 10 Aug 2026 · 💬 1
Listen to audio version of this article
Instaread
Sponsored by

There's a curious gap in today's supercar market: the big factories have largely stepped away from limited-run flagships, and into that vacuum have rushed the boutique builders — small firms with big ideas and clientele to match.

The latest arrival is a road-focused evolution of an off-road restomod we drove two years ago. The builder insists this is no quick suspension drop: only the doors and roof carry over, with the rest of the all-carbon bodywork reshaped around new intakes, reprofiled flanks, and a substantially more aggressive diffuser.

Power comes from a twin-turbo flat-six tuned to a round 900hp — every early buyer, we're told, ticked the upgrade box, so the higher output simply became standard. The claimed numbers: 0-62mph in under two and a half seconds and a top speed north of 200mph.

Refreshingly, there's no lap-time chest-beating. This machine is pitched as a usable road car rather than a track-attack special — which, given the seven-figure price and a production run capped at thirty cars, is probably how its owners will treat it.
